caption: The drawing depicts a single, transparent blue-green glass vessel with a rounded, bulbous body and a short, cylindrical neck that is slightly tilted to the right. The vessel is adorned with raised decorative elements: two spiral bands run vertically down each side of the body, and small rounded protrusions accent the vessel's shoulders and edges. The glass surface contains subtle reflections and shadowing, indicating its translucent quality. The vessel rests on a small, slightly flattened base, with the entire composition centered on an off-white background. The artist's name, "CHRIS MARRENOS," is written in small letters near the bottom right of the vessel.
title: Perfume Bottle
